prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a surreal and humorous image featuring a seagull standing upright at the center of a plain, light gray background. The seagull’s body is seamlessly merged with exaggerated, muscular human arms flexing outward in a classic bodybuilder pose, replacing its wings. The bird’s expression is neutral and natural, contrasting with the absurdity of its physique. Above the seagull, bold black text reads: “Has science gone too far? Is this image real or fake?” Below the seagull, a smaller line of text states: “97% fail this quiz.” At the bottom of the image, two large buttons are displayed side by side—one green labeled “Real” and one red labeled “Fake.” The overall composition is clean and minimalistic, with a focus on the central hybrid creature and the playful, internet-meme style quiz format. The lighting is even and soft, with no dramatic shadows, emphasizing the clarity and artificiality of the scene.
